The human body has a lot of plasticity, so changes in the immune system can explain why some people no longer react to certain irritants. On the other hand, a person who did not react strongly to peanuts in his/her childhood might later in life develop a serious sensitivity to the same food due to prolonged exposure. Overall, I think allergies are a combination of environmental factors and genetic predispositions. As we continue to make lifestyle choices that better our lives, allergies are becoming a thing of the past.
